PARAMS = {
    "Wpass":  (3000.0, 1500.0, 5000.0),   # pass PMOS width [um]
    "Lpass":  (0.3, 0.18, 0.5),           # pass PMOS length [um]
    "Cc":     (50e-12, 15e-12, 200e-12),  # Ahuja comp cap: cascode source -> vout
    "Cff":    (1e-12, 0.1e-12, 20e-12),   # feed-forward cap across R1
    "Rcas":   (35e3, 20e3, 60e3),         # sets cascode gate = Vgs_b + IREF*Rcas
    "Win":    (80.0, 20.0, 200.0),        # diff pair width (L=1)
    "Wload":  (60.0, 20.0, 150.0),        # PMOS mirror width (L=2)
    "ktail":  (3.0, 2.0, 3.5),            # tail current / IREF
    "kbleed": (2.0, 1.0, 2.5),            # output bleed current / IREF
    "Rdiv":   (120e3, 80e3, 300e3),       # total divider resistance
}

def _solve_vgs(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.05, 1.8
    r = None
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        r = lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)
        if r["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi), r

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = 10e-6
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    vout_t = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)

    Wb, Lb = 20.0, 1.0
    Wt = Wb * p["ktail"]
    Wbl = Wb * p["kbleed"]
    itail = iref * p["ktail"]
    ibleed = iref * p["kbleed"]
    R1 = p["Rdiv"] * (1.0 - vref / vout_t)
    R2 = p["Rdiv"] * (vref / vout_t)
    idiv = vout_t / p["Rdiv"]
    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)

    Lin, Lcas, Lload = 1.0, 0.5, 2.0
    Wcas = 20.0

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF -> Rcas -> diode Mb ; ibias node = cascode gate bias
    n.R("Rcas", "ibias", "nb", p["Rcas"])
    n.M("Mb", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lb)
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, Lb)
    n.M("Mbl", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbl, Lb)
    # diff pair: M1 (vref) -> output side, M2 (fb) -> diode side
    n.M("M1", "x", "vref", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], Lin)
    n.M("M2", "y", "fb", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], Lin)
    # NMOS cascodes
    n.M("Mc2", "g", "ibias", "x", "vss", "nfet", Wcas, Lcas)
    n.M("Mc1", "pd", "ibias", "y", "vss", "nfet", Wcas, Lcas)
    # PMOS mirror load (vin referenced -> gate tracks vin)
    n.M("Mp1", "pd", "pd", "vin", "vin", "pfet", p["Wload"], Lload)
    n.M("Mp2", "g", "pd", "vin", "vin", "pfet", p["Wload"], Lload)
    # pass device
    n.M("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", p["Wpass"], p["Lpass"])
    # feedback divider + feed-forward
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("Cff", "vout", "fb", p["Cff"])
    # Ahuja compensation: cascode source node -> vout
    n.C("Cc", "x", "vout", p["Cc"])

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    iq = iref + itail + ibleed + idiv
    try:
        _, rin = _solve_vgs(lut, "n", p["Win"], Lin, itail / 2, 0.15, 0.12)
        gm1 = rin["gm"]
        _, rl = _solve_vgs(lut, "p", p["Wload"], Lload, itail / 2, 0.9)
        _, rc = _solve_vgs(lut, "n", Wcas, Lcas, itail / 2, 0.5, 0.25)
        gds_n_eff = rin["gds"] * rc["gds"] / max(rc["gm"], 1e-12)
        A = gm1 / (rl["gds"] + gds_n_eff)
        ip_min = imin + ibleed + idiv
        ip_max = imax + ibleed + idiv
        vsg_min, rpmin = _solve_vgs(lut, "p", p["Wpass"], p["Lpass"], ip_min, 0.6)
        vsg_max, rpmax = _solve_vgs(lut, "p", p["Wpass"], p["Lpass"], ip_max, 0.6)
        dvsg = vsg_max - vsg_min
        cg = rpmax.get("cgg", p["Wpass"] * p["Lpass"] * 10e-15)
    except Exception:
        gm1, A = 3e-4, 400.0
        dvsg = 0.3
        rpmin = {"gm": 1.3e-3, "gds": 4e-5}
        rpmax = {"gm": 6e-2, "gds": 2e-3}
        cg = p["Wpass"] * p["Lpass"] * 10e-15
        vsg_max = 1.05

    Ab = A * beta
    load_reg = dvsg / Ab / (imax - imin) + 1.0 / (Ab * rpmax["gm"])
    gratio = max(rpmin["gm"] / max(rpmin["gds"], 1e-12), 1.0)
    line_reg = 1.0 / (Ab * gratio) + 1.0 / (Ab * 50.0)
    fu = gm1 * beta / (2 * PI * p["Cc"])
    t1k = min(Ab, fu / 1e3)
    psrr = 20 * math.log10(max(t1k * min(gratio, 30.0), 1.0))
    gate_gain = p["Cc"] / max(cg, 1e-13)
    undershoot = dvsg / (1.0 + gate_gain) + imax * 30e-9 / cl
    overshoot = dvsg * 0.6
    p2 = rpmin["gm"] * p["Cc"] / (2 * PI * max(cg, 1e-13) * cl)
    pm_ratio = p2 / max(fu, 1.0)
    vout_err = 100.0 * (0.002 + 1.0 / max(Ab, 1.0))

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "iq": iq,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": overshoot,
        "ripple_settled": 1e-3 if pm_ratio > 1.5 else 2e-2,
    }
